scope: development requirements and hazards; not an execution authorization

requirements.requirement: Nia is the sole installed-package and ownership writer
requirements.hazard: independent APT/dpkg/PackageKit or Nia writers can publish conflicting state
requirements.remaining: connect the actual native executor, GUI and automatic updates; prove absence of other writers in a new image

requirements.requirement: Preserve native dependency and effect semantics without falsified compatibility
requirements.hazard: dropping metadata or executing unmodeled scripts violates update and rollback contracts
requirements.remaining: authenticate original artifacts and implement every adopted phase, generated output and implicit trigger

requirements.requirement: Bounded staging must retain one recoverable root/catalog publication boundary
requirements.hazard: individually committed file-plan chunks expose a partially updated system
requirements.remaining: compose existing component SDKs with generation publication, interruption/fsync/space/lock/replay tests and independent trust rollback rules

requirements.requirement: Check real mitigation values and exact first-party artifacts
requirements.hazard: a configuration flag or successful build is mistaken for effective protection
requirements.remaining: native image integration, hardware and performance qualification

requirements.requirement: Constrain the read-only Nia observer while preserving its documented observations
requirements.hazard: profile presence is mistaken for actual enforcement or required reads are silently lost
requirements.remaining: connect installation, enablement and updates to native configuration effects; this does not confine all Nia workers
